<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.py from data/scenarios.json. Edit the JSON. -->

Run with `--cycle 240` to alternate healthy phases and these faults, or pin one with `--scenario NAME`. The alerts listed are the ones each fault is designed to trigger; thresholds are calibrated to the demo traffic.

### `slow-model`: Model latency + streaming stalls

**What changes:** Model latency x3.5, 8% of streams stall mid-answer

**What you see**

- TTFT p95 rises; stalls per turn rise
- Abandonment rises, containment falls a little

**Alerts:** `ChatTTFTHigh` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#latency-regression)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: TTFT by channel; Turn error ratio & streaming stalls
- TraceQL: `{ span.stream.stalled = true }`

### `hallucinating`: Quality regression

**What changes:** Probability that a conversation is solvable -0.40

**What you see**

- Containment falls; escalation and thumbs-down rise
- Goal-completion judge score falls
- Latency, errors and cost look normal

**Alerts:** `ChatContainmentDrop`, `ChatEscalationSpike`, `ChatGoalCompletionLow` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#conversation-quality-or-containment-drop)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Containment by intent; Conversation-level eval scores
- Read escalated conversations (redacted), check recent prompt/model changes

### `over-refusal`: Guardrail too strict

**What changes:** 22% of turns refused by the guardrail

**What you see**

- Refusals per turn rise; escalation rises, containment falls
- Policy-compliance score dips; quality score otherwise fine

**Alerts:** `ChatOverRefusal` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#conversation-quality-or-containment-drop)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Guardrail refusals by intent
- TraceQL: `{ span.guardrail.refused = true }`
- Review a sample of refused turns for false positives

### `long-context`: History bloat

**What changes:** Context size x5

**What you see**

- Context utilization p95 rises; truncation events
- Cost per conversation rises

**Alerts:** `ChatContextNearLimit`, `ChatCostPerSessionSpike` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#context-window-pressure)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Context window utilization; Cost per conversation
- TraceQL: `{ span.context.truncated = true }`

### `outage`: Provider errors

**What changes:** 35% of model calls fail

**What you see**

- Turn error ratio rises; abandonment rises
- Containment falls

**Alerts:** `ChatTurnErrors` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#provider-errors-and-rate-limits)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Turn error ratio
- Logs: `|= "model call failed"`
- TraceQL: `{ status = error }`
